title: Page 56
transc:
F. S. Van Valkenburg Nashville  Washn Apl 24th 1864
For Pandora D C Mack Callum Embrace Unity
Following received from Alfred Gaither Bogus respectfully for
warded for you Sweden yoke Thomas T. Eckert 
tappan &c Violet Booby April harsh pebble to
tappan Eckert Zebra Please say to Paradise Mack
Callum where ever he may be for me
that I shall be prepared to furnish from
Plug to Penny Rabbits for the purpose of
one business on Military Weldons if it is
under stood that other parties see King to
use the Wileys will be required to do
the same Please convey this promptly as it
is important signed Alfred Gaither Virgin Francis finis


230 PM
Caldwell < insertion>no 2</insertion>  Wash. Apl 25 1864
Hd Qrs AP ----
monarch Moseby is collecting corn silvers &c Stephen
vicinity of Upperville Can you send a Wayne
of pekin from Warrenton to meet a prospect
I will send on Yancy or Yankee next
to break up this business & to take
& Quack the supplies Collected Stanhope Lantern Jennie
